findings.title: run_formatter_safely does not validate return type; None-returning formatter silently emits the string "None"
findings.description: The stdout-write guard captures bytes written to sys.stdout during fn(), and the exception guard converts any raise to error_exit. However there is no runtime check that fn() returns a str. If a third-party formatter returns None (missing return statement), output=None is passed to click.echo(None), which prints the literal string "None" to stdout, and the process exits with the domain exit code rather than 2. The leaked-buffer check is not triggered because None came back as the return value, not as a write to the buffer. The contract-violation codepath is not exercised.
findings.impact: A misbehaving --formatter-module formatter that forgets a return statement emits "None" on stdout with no error signal. CI consumers piping output to a JUnit parser or SARIF ingester receive malformed input and fail downstream with a confusing parse error rather than a clean protokit error.
findings.recommendation: After the redirect_stdout block, check isinstance(output, str). If output is not a str, call error_exit with a message such as "formatter X must return str, got {type(output).__name__}". This closes the same contract-violation path as the buffer guard.

findings.title: Commit-phase rollback in load_formatter_pack catches only FormatterError; non-FormatterError exceptions escape without rollback and without error_exit
findings.description: The commit loop catches only FormatterError to trigger rollback. Any other exception escaping register_formatter propagates without rollback (leaving partial _REGISTRY state) and then bubbles through load_formatter_packs whose except clause also narrowly names (AttributeError, TypeError, FormatterError). An unexpected exception prints a Python traceback instead of the clean error_exit message every other failure path produces. Today register_formatter raises only FormatterError, so this is a latent risk from future refactors rather than a current path.
findings.impact: Under current code, only FormatterError escapes register_formatter and rollback works correctly. The gap is latent: the rollback try/except is narrowly typed to one exception class, which is fragile under future change.
findings.recommendation: Widen the except in the commit phase to except Exception: (re-raising after rollback). Correspondingly widen the except in load_formatter_packs to except Exception: so error_exit is always called.

findings.title: bisect commits_walked reports total range size rather than actual iterations in stop-fast exit paths
findings.description: In the bisect subcommand, _emit_and_exit is called with commits_walked=len(commits) in both stop-fast exit paths (early diagnostic exit and early break exit). len(commits) is the total number of commits in the range, not the number processed before the early exit. A bisect over 50 commits that stops at commit 3 reports commits_walked=50.
findings.impact: Consumers of --format json or custom formatters that use BisectReport.commits_walked for CI metrics will see inflated walk counts in stop-fast mode. Data fidelity issue, not a crash path.

residual_risks.description: click.echo stdout interception works correctly today because click _default_text_stdout calls lambda: sys.stdout at invocation time, making redirect_stdout transparent to click.echo. Verified by reading .venv/lib/python3.13/site-packages/click/_compat.py:_make_cached_stream_func. If a future click version caches the stream object at import time rather than at call time, click.echo calls inside formatters would bypass the guard silently.

Inter-pack rollback gap: if --formatter-module A B C is given and pack C fails mid-commit, pack A and B formatters remain in _REGISTRY. Rollback in load_formatter_pack is intra-pack only. error_exit terminates the process immediately so leaked state has no observable CLI effect. Risk is limited to test code that invokes load_formatter_packs in-process and catches SystemExit.

testing_gaps.description: No test covers a formatter that returns None. The stdout-write guard and exception guard are tested, but a fn returning None exercises a gap: today it silently outputs the string None. After REL-001 is fixed, a test should assert error_exit is raised for None-returning formatters.
testing_gaps.location: tests/ (no existing coverage for None-returning formatter path in run_formatter_safely)

testing_gaps.description: No test exercises the multi-module --formatter-module A B C scenario where C fails after A and B succeed. The intra-pack rollback path appears covered but the cross-pack residual state after error_exit should be verified in an in-process test that catches SystemExit.
